# A fake stand-in for the data file Renovate renders from
# postUpgradeTasks.dataFileTemplate, so the script can be tried by hand. Lines that are
# not a "<package>==<version>" pin are ignored. Each pin must be newer than the version
# the lockfiles hold, or there is nothing to propagate. Regenerating takes minutes per
# directory. Run in a throwaway worktree to keep the checkout unchanged:
#   git worktree add --detach /tmp/resync-tryout HEAD
#   cd /tmp/resync-tryout
#   ./.github/renovate/resync_lockfiles.py .github/renovate/resync_lockfiles.example.txt
#   git --no-pager diff
#   git worktree remove --force /tmp/resync-tryout
aiohttp==3.14.5
